verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference API, and operating such a product through natural language (for example, managing keys, usage or models conversationally) is a fair axis. The evidence shows no such capability. It documents OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, a key-and-usage console, and llms.txt/OpenAPI docs. Its models accept natural-language prompts and it can back agents like Claude Code, but those are the product's inference function and developer building blocks, not natural-language control of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
